summary.zh-CN: 全连接层让每个输出单元接收全部输入，每条连接都有自己的权重。各单元对输入加权求和，并可加上自己的偏置，把一组输入特征组合成一组新特征。
summary.en-US: A fully connected layer lets every output unit receive every input, with a separate weight for each connection. Each unit computes a weighted sum of the inputs and can add its own bias, combining one set of features into another.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 全连接层的每条连接对应一个权重，每个输出单元对应一组权重。把这些权重按输出单元排成行，就能用矩阵乘法一次表示整层计算。
coreConclusion.en-US: Each connection in a fully connected layer has one weight, and each output unit has one weight vector. Arrange those vectors as rows to express the whole layer with matrix multiplication.
